answer: The summit schedule is applied in cedar and shale reveals each instalment. A payout is split thus 25% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1702 identities would post 703 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
